image_description: Two translucent teal plastic disposable lighters standing upright against a white background with faint, blurry text/graphics. The lighter on the left shows a side profile with the spark wheel and guard visible; the one on the right is angled slightly differently. Both have standard rectangular bodies with rounded corners and metal wind guards at the top.

artifact_observations.location: Background, primarily right side and bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, nonsensical character-like shapes float in the background. They resemble deconstructed letters or watermarks but are illegible and structurally incoherent, indicating AI generation artifacts in texture synthesis.

artifact_observations.location: Plastic body of the right lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight inconsistency in refraction/translucency. The internal details appear somewhat 'muddy' or smeared rather than having crisp optical boundaries expected from clear plastic.

artifact_observations.location: Spark wheel assembly on the left lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The serrations on the spark wheel are slightly irregular and lack the precise mechanical uniformity of a real manufactured part, appearing slightly melted or soft.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the objects are indeed lighters and not misclassified similar objects (e.g., USB drives, vapes).
To check for edge bleeding between the translucent plastic and the white background, and to ensure the object is a single continuous mesh without floating parts.
To verify the spatial relationship between the two lighters and ensure the background gibberish doesn't interfere with foreground depth perception.
To specifically analyze the gibberish text artifacts in the background to determine if they are failed attempts at rendering brand logos or instructions.

focus_areas: Mechanical precision of the spark wheel and wind guard
Legibility and structure of background text artifacts
Edge sharpness between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. While it is in the background, its presence confirms AI generation. Evaluate if the structural integrity of the lighter mechanisms (spark wheel) is physically plausible despite minor aesthetic softness. Do not penalize heavily for lack of flame since the object is static/unlit.
